programme.title: Insomnia
programme.desc: It's a polar summer in northern Alaska.Police officer Will Dormer (Al Pacino) arrives in the town of Nightmute with his partner Hap Eckhart (Martin Donovan).The men are to find the perpetrator of the murder of a seventeen-year-old girl.Will doesn't feel comfortable up north.The polar summer deepens his insomnia.The trail leads to writer Walter Finch (Robin Williams), who was friends with the victim.While chasing him in the thick fog, Will shoots his partner.Hap dies.In his last words, he accuses Will of doing it to prevent an internal investigation.Dormer covers his tracks by directing suspicions at Finch.A writer who witnessed Hap's murder begins to blackmail Will.Meanwhile, local policewoman Ellie Burr (Hilary Swank) is getting closer to discovering the truth about Hap's death.

programme.title: 4 from there
programme.desc: Another installment of the adventures of people living in a town straight from a nightmare.It is a terrifying place that traps anyone who crosses its borders.Desperate residents fight to stay alive.

programme.title: House of the Dragon 2
programme.desc: The second series of the production, the events of which precede the action of "Game of Thrones".After the death of Lucerys Velaryon, the son of Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen (Emma D'Arcy), which was caused by his cousin, Aemond Targaryen (Ewan Mitchell), Westeros finds itself on the brink of a bloody civil war.The Green Council supporting King Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) and Queen Rhaenyra's Black Council are fighting for influence.Each side claims the Iron Throne.The dynamic development of events also affects the attitude of Rhaenyra's husband, Daemon (Matt Smith), in life.A man who spends a lot of time in Harrenhal Castle, away from his wife, changes a lot.In addition, the demons of his past begin to haunt him.

credits.actor: King Aegon II Targaryen - Tom Glynn-Carney
Lord Corlys 'The Sea Snake' Velaryon - Steve Toussaint

programme.title: Amrum
programme.desc: Spring 1945. Twelve-year-old Nanning hunts seals and works hard in the fields to help his mother.He faces difficult decisions.

credits.actor: Der alte Mann am Meer - Hark Bohm

programme.title: L'immensita
programme.desc: 1970s. The Borghetti family lives in Rome, is attached to tradition and seems very happy.However, this is only an appearance.Clara (Penélope Cruz) and Felice (Vincenzo Amato) no longer feel love for each other, in fact they don't remember why they decided to get married.The decision to break up, although it seems logical, is unfortunately not easy at all.Clara, repeatedly cheated on by her husband, feels a true bond only with her three children, whose presence provides her with an escape from her overwhelming loneliness.It is for them that she still pretends to be a perfect housewife and tries her best to protect the hearth.Deep down, however, she is not happy.Important cultural and social changes are taking place in the background, which causes the couple's eldest daughter, twelve-year-old Adriana (Luana Giuliani), to become bold and declare that she is a boy.This unexpected announcement leads to a situation in which family relations become even more strained.The film was shown at the Venice International Film Festival.Contains autobiographical threads.Director Emanuele Crialese confessed during the festival that he was inspired by his own childhood.

programme.title: Locke
programme.desc: Ivan Locke (Tom Hardy) is one of the best civil engineers in England.He has just finished working on a construction site in Birmingham and is driving to London, where he lives.Tomorrow is the most important day of his career so far, and it is related to the project of a gigantic apartment building.While traveling home, Ivan receives one phone call that completely changes his life... Tom Hardy and Steven Knight had already met during the production of the second season of the series about English gangs of the 1920s, entitled"Peaky Blinders".Hardy played the boss of a Jewish gang, Alfie Salomons, and Knight co-wrote the script.

programme.title: Manodrome
programme.desc: Ralphie (Jesse Eisenberg) recently lost his job.He barely makes ends meet by moonlighting as an Uber driver, while his partner Sal (Odessa Young) is about to give birth.Ralphie is not prepared for his new role, and his problems make it difficult for him to control his emotions.Seeing his helplessness and growing frustration, his gym friend Jason introduces him to the charismatic Dan (Adrien Brody), the leader of a mysterious group of celibate men who preach patriarchy.Ralphie, in crisis, is drawn into their world.Over time, he develops a dangerous obsession.

programme.title: The Goldsmith's Secret
programme.desc: 1999. Goldsmith Juan Pablo travels from Spain to New York for an exhibition of his works.On the way he passes through his hometown.He will meet Celia, a great love who changed his life.

programme.title: Merry Madagascar
programme.desc: Friends from the New York Zoo - Alex the lion, Melman the giraffe, Gloria the hippopotamus and Marty the zebra - are still in Madagascar and dream of returning to their beloved home.Just before Christmas, they contribute to an unfortunate accident involving Santa Claus, who crashes his sleigh on the island.To make matters worse, the children's favorite suffers from amnesia.Four friends, with the help of penguins, plan to save Christmas and hand out gifts.They also want to take advantage of the situation to return to the zoo.Meanwhile, the penguins start a war with the reindeer... In the Polish version, they lent their voices to characters including:Artur Żmijewski, Małgorzata Kożuchowska and Piotr Adamczyk.

programme.title: Alita: Battle Angel
programme.desc: Alita (Rosa Salazar), a cyborg girl, wakes up from a coma.It turns out that he doesn't remember who he is or where he is.Doctor Ido (Christoph Waltz) subjected her to a series of tests that revealed that she was a young woman with a unique story.Wanting to protect her, he does not reveal the truth about her past.Alita must adapt to the conditions and rules of life in Scrap City.After some time, he regains his memory thanks to the help of his friend, Hugo (Keean Johnson).Then he realizes that he has incredible fighting skills.She must use them against the power that tries to control her.The film's director is Robert Rodriguez, known from "From Dusk Till Dawn" and "Machete".The script was written by the winner of three Oscars, James Cameron, who considered making "Alita" back in the 1990s. The film was based on the manga.

programme.title: Long Good Thursday
programme.desc: Finland.A widowed farmer becomes a model for the eccentric artist Saimi.A feeling develops between them.This does not please the man's adult sons, who are afraid of losing their property.

programme.title: Christmas In The Spotlight
programme.desc: The singer and the football player start dating before Christmas.The public is following the development of their relationship with interest.The couple must decide whether the affair will turn into a lasting relationship.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Peter La Fleur owns a small gym.The club has a few friendly clients - among them the shy Gordon, Steve and Owen, who is constantly looking for true love - but it does not make a profit.One day, the man is visited by lawyer Kate Veatch, representing the bank.He declares that the indebted premises will be taken over by White Goodman's network of thriving clubs.The only salvation for the Le Fleur club seems to be the upcoming dodgeball competition, in which the main prize is $50,000.From the helpless members of his club, Peter forms a team whose enthusiasm far exceeds their skills.Goodman does not give up and puts his players on the field.

programme.title: The Grinch
programme.desc: The only companion of the lonely and malicious Grinch is the dog Max. The green creature only leaves the cave in search of food.Meanwhile, the residents of Whosiów are eagerly awaiting a special time of the year, Christmas.Wanting to keep the peace, the Grinch plans to spoil the grand celebrations and kidnap Santa Claus.At the same time, Cindy-Lou and her friends intend to capture a Lappish benefactor to thank him for helping the girl's busy mother.Two opposing intentions will face an inevitable confrontation.Another film adaptation of the adventures of a character created by a children's book writer, Dr.Seuss.Previously, Jim Carrey played the green creature in the 2000 film "The Grinch: No Christmas."In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Jarosław Boberek, Lila Wassermann, Ewa Prus and Karol Kwiatkowski.The carol was performed by Katarzyna Owczarz, Małgorzata Szymańska, Adam Krylik and Krzysztof Pietrzak.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Eclipse
programme.desc: After a painful separation, Bella and her lover can enjoy each other's company again.The teenager wants to be transformed into an immortal being, which will allow them to be united forever.Before that, however, he has to take care of more mundane matters - pass his high school leaving exams and get into college.In addition, he is worried about his friend Jacob.It turns out that soon he and Edward will have to join forces to ensure the safety of the girl who has won their hearts.The relative peace of all the bloodsuckers and werewolves of Forks is disturbed by disturbing news from Seattle.It turns out that mysterious murders are taking place there.People are being killed by a pack of vampires, spreading fear and destruction around.The gang is recruiting new members.It is headed by Riley.He was chosen as the leader by the vengeful Victoria, who is seeking Bella's life.Thanks to Alice's visions and the Cullens' vigilance, they manage to protect her.Enemy races unite in the face of danger.

programme.title: What Happens Later
programme.desc: The inveterate dreamer Willa (Meg Ryan) and the pessimist Bill (David Duchovny), who once had feelings for each other, meet by chance at the airport after many years.Their plans are thwarted by a massive snowstorm, which forces them to wait for the canceled flights to resume.They haven't seen each other for over two decades.She is a masseuse practicing spiritual rituals, he is a down-to-earth corporate employee.They didn't part peacefully, so even though a lot of time has passed, they have a lot of explaining to do.They start talking not only about their current lives, but also about their painful past.Willa is lonely, although she always wanted a family.Bill has a wife and a daughter, but not everything is perfect between them.Former lovers discuss why they went their separate ways.They wonder what would have happened if it hadn't happened.They have the opportunity to finally say to each other what has not been said out loud before.It turns out that they are still not indifferent to each other.Based on the play by Steven Dietz.

programme.title: Batman Azteca: Choque de Imperios
programme.desc: Times of the Aztec Empire.The village leader, Toltecatzin, is murdered by the conquistadors.His son, Yohualli Coatl, flees to Tenochtitlán to warn King Moctezuma and his high priest Yoka.

programme.title: Mr. Kleks' Academy 2
programme.desc: Ada (Antonina Litwiniak) returns to school headed by Kleks (Tomasz Kot).He tries to solve the mystery of Albert's origins.The professor himself leaves the Academy in search of his old friend.

programme.title: Guy Ritchie's the Covenant
programme.desc: March 2018.There is a war in Afghanistan.Master Sergeant John Kinley (Jake Gyllenhaal) and his unit are ambushed by the Taliban during a routine vehicle inspection.The American translator dies in it.He will be replaced by Ahmed Abdullah (Dar Salim).During a secret mission, Kinley learns that his new associate had previous ties to the Taliban.He escaped when the organization murdered his son.Over time, an alliance develops between him and the American soldier.Ahmed saves John, who after some time gains the opportunity to repay his debt.

credits.actor: Master Sergeant John Kinley - Jake Gyllenhaal

programme.title: Rumble Through the Dark
programme.desc: Jack Boucher (Aaron Eckhart), once an undefeated boxer, now lives in poverty, tormented by memories of the orphanage.In debt to Big Momma Sweet (Marianne Jean-Baptiste), he tries to win at the casino.

programme.title: River Wild
programme.desc: Idaho.Doctor Joey (Leighton Meester) goes to meet Brother Gray (Taran Killam), who is organizing a rafting trip on the Salmon River.There he meets his long-time friend Trevor (Adam Brody), who is on parole, and two young women.Initially, the rafting takes place in a relaxed atmosphere.Everything changes on their first night together, when the kayakers set up camp.One of the young women suffers serious injuries.The circumstances of the incident are unclear, and the injured party herself claims that she was the victim of an attack.The incident disturbs the peace of Joey and the other participants of the expedition.However, it turns out that this is only the beginning of the problems.

programme.title: Alien: Romulus
programme.desc: The year 2142. The Jackson's Star mining colony was established on the distant planet LV-410.The workers include orphaned Rain (Cailee Spaeny) and Andy (David Jonsson), a robot reprogrammed by her father.The girl wants to escape to a better world, but her forced labor contract is extended by the corporation.Together with his brother android, he joins the rebels who discovered that there is an abandoned research station hovering over the planet.The fugitives get aboard and discover cryogenic chambers, thanks to which they can make a long interplanetary journey.However, they do not know that there is also a bloodthirsty beast on the ship that they will have to face.A continuation of the famous SF horror series, well received by critics and viewers.The action takes place between the events of "Alien - 8th Passenger of the Nostromo" by Ridley Scott and "Alien - The Decisive Engagement" by James Cameron.

programme.title: Monsters vs Aliens: Mutant Pumpkins from Outer Space
programme.desc: Susan Murphy and a group of friendly monsters undertake another mission.Just before Halloween, a trace of aliens was found in the girl's hometown.Everything looked normal though.Unexpectedly, on the day of the holiday, the innocent-looking pumpkin lanterns reveal their true colors.It turns out to be an invasion of aliens who plan to conquer Earth.Susan, called Ginormica, and a team of "freaks of nature" start a fight against mutated pumpkins... In the Polish language version, the characters provided their voices, among others:Barbara Kałużna, Wojciech Paszkowski and Grzegorz Pawlak.

programme.title: La grazia
programme.desc: The President of Italy (Toni Servillo) is at the end of his term.In six months, his political and social role will come to an end.At this time, the head of state faces moral dilemmas caused by the euthanasia regulations and the issue of pardoning two life sentences.Every decision will expose the politician to criticism, but it is up to him to decide which crime deserves forgiveness: an act of mercy or murder.Bending under the weight of responsibility, the statesman tries to buy time.At the same time, he struggles with personal problems.Despite the passage of 40 years, he still has not forgiven his deceased wife's betrayal, and he cannot find the way to his daughter (Anna Ferzetti).Ultimately, however, it proves that even if you know yourself perfectly, you can make a decision that will surprise everyone and bring inner freedom.

programme.title: Eddie the Eagle
programme.desc: British ski jumper Michael 'Eddie' Edwards, although not successful, believes in his abilities.Thanks to the help of a charismatic coach, in 1988 he took part in the Olympics in Calgary.

credits.actor: Richmond the BOA Official - Mark Benton

programme.title: Ghostlight
programme.desc: Grieving construction worker Dan (Keith Kupferer) joins a local theater group working on a production of Romeo and Juliet.There are changes in his life.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn - Part 1
programme.desc: Bella Swan and Edward Cullen are getting married.They spend their honeymoon on a private island in Brazil belonging to the groom's family.Two weeks later, Bella discovers she is pregnant.The fetus is developing at a rapid pace.The couple returns to Forks.It turns out that Bella's condition means great danger to her.The werewolves, led by Sam, want to kill her unborn offspring, who may turn out to be a demon.Jacob defies his pack and decides to protect his lost loved one.The Cullen family prepares for a difficult birth.Edward will have to fight to save the person he loves with all his heart.

programme.title: Ford v Ferrari
programme.desc: The victory in the prestigious race goes to the Ferrari team every year.Henry Ford II intends to dethrone the full-time champion.He thinks about building a car that will leave the competition behind.For this purpose, he asks for help from two specialists.One of them is the temperamental fast driving enthusiast Ken Miles.The second one is Carroll Shelby, who can boast of winning Le Mans, and some time ago, due to health problems, he gave up his driving career and took up car design.They both immediately take up the challenge, even though they know that there is a long way to achieve their goal.They quickly encounter resistance from officials.It turns out that they must immerse themselves in the world of ruthless bureaucracy to take part in the twenty-four-hour race.

programme.title: The Front Runner
programme.desc: Senator Gary Hart (Hugh Jackman) is extremely popular, especially among younger voters.In 1988, he decided to run for the presidency of the United States for the second time.He is considered by many to be the favorite.However, unexpectedly, his extramarital relationship with Donna Rice (Sara Paxton) comes to light.The media is publicizing this case, and Hart's career is in question... The director and screenwriter of the film, Jason Reitman, was nominated for the Festival Award at the Toronto International Film Festival.

programme.title: The Greatest Showman
programme.desc: P. T. Barnum (Ellis Rubin) is the son of a tailor who works for the Hallett family.The boy falls in love with his employers' daughter, Charity (Skylar Dunn).They stay in touch for many years, and when they are adults, they get married.One day, Phineas (Hugh Jackman) loses his job.Wanting to ensure the happiness of his wife (Michelle Williams) and two daughters, a man opens a wax museum.When the idea turns out to be unsuccessful, he decides to show visitors living exhibits.He employs outstanding people - including: the acrobat Anne (Zendaya) and her brother W. D. (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II), the woman with the beard Lettie Lutz (Keala Settle) and Charles Stratton (Sam Humphrey).The show attracts a large audience but receives negative reviews;Barnum's museum is called a circus.To improve his reputation, the man invites Phillip Carlyle (Zac Efron) to cooperate with him.He soon meets Swedish singer Jenny Lind (Rebecca Ferguson).The artist's performance turns out to be a breakthrough for his career.

programme.title: Cash For Gold
programme.desc: American province.After the death of her soldier husband in Afghanistan, Grace (Deborah Puette), a single mother, loses herself in alcohol addiction.The widow, in order to provide a decent life for her son (Sawyer Gacka) and protect their house from being taken over by the bank, decides to fight for a change of fate.He joins an AA group and takes a job in a pawn shop owned by the only Muslim family in town.Over time, her friendly relationship with the owners of the plant, Mohammad (Marcelo Tubert) and his son, Hasan (Farshad Farahat), becomes less and less popular with the local community.
